system.description: A Focus for a character whose implanted electronics make them a powerful mental interface.

abilities.name: Data Processor
abilities.description: Temporarily become trained in one Intellect skill; Effort increases the number of temporary trained skills.

abilities.name: Think Fast
abilities.description: You are trained in Intellect defense tasks.

abilities.name: Wireless Interface
abilities.description: Communicate mentally with willing machines in short range; contacts make their tasks faster and last until recovery.

abilities.name: Analytic Processor
abilities.description: Ask the GM a question and attempt an Intellect task for a short answer; failure causes 4 Intellect damage.

abilities.name: Machine Reading
abilities.description: Read the surface thoughts of a visible machine in short range until recovery.

abilities.name: Action Processor
abilities.description: Data Processor can also grant training in physical skills and a specific weapon attack.

abilities.name: Awareness
abilities.description: Sense living and thinking machines at long range and study one target's health and power.

abilities.name: Expanded Wireless
abilities.description: Wireless Interface reaches anywhere on the planet.

abilities.name: Locked Skill
abilities.description: Lock one Data Processor skill until a ten-hour recovery; you can select this ability up to three times.

abilities.name: Precognition
abilities.description: Gain assets on defense, detecting deception and traps, and interaction tasks until recovery.

abilities.name: Machine Enhancement
abilities.description: Effort on an Intellect action also grants a free Effort level or a minor effect.

abilities.name: Mind Surge
abilities.description: Gain one extra one-action recovery each day that replenishes only Intellect.
